mapper.select: SELECT s.seat_id, s.room_id, s.row_name, s.col_num, (bs.booked_seat_id IS NOT NULL) AS is_booked FROM seats s LEFT JOIN booked_seats bs ON bs.seat_id = s.seat_id AND bs.screening_id = #{screeningId} AND bs.is_active = TRUE WHERE s.room_id = #{roomId} AND s.is_active = TRUE ORDER BY s.row_name, s.col_num

SELECT s.seat_id, s.room_id, s.row_name, s.col_num, s.is_active AS active FROM seats s JOIN rooms r ON r.room_id = s.room_id WHERE r.cinema_id = #{cinemaId} AND r.room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY s.row_name, s.col_num

SELECT b.booking_id, b.user_id, u.login_id, sc.screening_id, sc.screening_date, sc.start_time, m.title AS movie_title FROM booked_seats bs JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id = bs.booking_id JOIN screenings sc ON sc.screening_id = bs.screening_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = b.user_id LEFT JOIN movies m ON m.movie_id = sc.movie_id WHERE bs.seat_id = #{seatId} AND b.booking_status = 'DONE' AND sc.screening_date + sc.end_time + CASE WHEN sc.end_time <= sc.start_time THEN INTERVAL '1 day' ELSE INTERVAL '0 days' END > (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') ORDER BY sc.screening_date, sc.start_time, b.booking_id
mapper.update: UPDATE seats SET is_active = #{active} WHERE seat_id = #{seatId}
